summary: Negros Occidental 6th District representative (Deputy Speaker per the House site) with 77 principal-authored bills. Reviewed bills favor worker protection and cash or fuel assistance.
caveat: Low confidence; mostly co-authored bills. A press release on amending gender-biased infidelity provisions was seen but not dated, so it was not used.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Principal author of Magna Carta for waste workers (labor); co-author of one-time cash assistance, free professional exams for indigents and fuel-subsidy mechanism (state support). Mostly co-authored; no market-leaning evidence found.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB02031, HB02488, HB02489, HB08494 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB03023, HB09642 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Insufficient evidence
democratic.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.
